verdict.rationale: The evidence supports only adjacent review workflows. The plan agent can analyze code and review suggestions without making changes, and the permission config can make actions prompt before they run. The GitHub integration opens PRs from a branch and runs tasks in a GitHub Actions runner, so changes land as reviewable PRs. Missing for 10: any documented diff viewer or diff inspection of agent changes, any evidence of running tests, linters or other pre-merge checks, and any hands-on corroboration of a review workflow.
